evidence.selection: Three purposefully selected drone/background pairs from TRIDENT, RFVS, and Halmstad. These six examples are not a random sample or a performance estimate.
evidence.testDisclosure: TRIDENT repeats evaluation of recordings already evaluated in Version 1. External examples retain the released no-retraining evaluation. These selections are not an untouched confirmatory holdout.
evidence.labels: TRIDENT windows inherit presence labels. RFVS uses released sample labels. Halmstad uses recording classes. Frame-level visibility is not independently established here.
evidence.timing: TRIDENT uses 1 s windows at 0.25 s hops. Halmstad has nonoverlapping 1 s camera windows. RFVS is a camera still paired with 30 ms RF, without video playback. None is a latency measurement.
evidence.scores: Exact released cached probability values, without interpolation, recalibration, or new inference.
